Diagnosis:
CAUSE: Pod `payments-5bc47dccd9-66lgs` in namespace `shop` is Running but not Ready because its readiness probe (`nslookup kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local`) times out, and the NetworkPolicy `deny-all` in `shop` denies all egress, including DNS.

EVIDENCE:
1. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe pod payments-5bc47dccd9-66lgs -n shop`: Ready=False, ContainersReady=False, Restart Count 0, readiness `exec [nslookup kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local] delay=0s timeout=5s period=10s #success=1 #failure=2`, container `payments` started with `echo payments up; sleep 36000`.
2. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab get events -n shop --sort-by=.lastTimestamp`: Warning Unhealthy on pod/payments-5bc47dccd9-66lgs, "Readiness probe failed: command timed out: \"nslookup kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local\" timed out after 5s", repeated 15 times over 2m18s.
3. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab get networkpolicy -n shop -o yaml`: NetworkPolicy `deny-all` has `podSelector: {}`, `policyTypes: [Egress]` and no egress rules, so every pod in `shop` loses egress, including DNS to kube-dns.
4. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab logs payments-5bc47dccd9-66lgs -n shop` (reported by diag-k8s): "payments up". The container runs; only the probe fails.
5. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab get deploy payments -n shop -o yaml` (reported by diag-k8s): only revision 1 exists (ReplicaSet `payments-5bc47dccd9`), `Available=False` with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable, unavailableReplicas 1. The probe is in the template, so the egress block is the change to look at.
6. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab diff -f desired/` (reported by diag-k8s): exit code 2 with `namespaces "drift-lab" not found`, so no drift result was obtained.

FIX (not applied): add an egress rule to NetworkPolicy `deny-all` in `shop` that allows UDP and TCP port 53 to the kube-dns pods in `kube-system` (or remove `deny-all`), so the readiness probe's DNS lookup can resolve.

Fact.Name: cause
Fact.Value: NetworkPolicy `deny-all` (`podSelector: {}`, `policyTypes: [Egress]`, no egress rule) blocks DNS, 53/UDP to kube-dns

Fact.Name: fix (not applied)
Fact.Value: allow egress to kube-dns on 53/UDP and 53/TCP, or remove `deny-all`
